caption: The drawing features a wooden vanity with a mirror positioned on top of a light beige or cream-colored surface. The vanity is crafted from a dark brown wood with a polished finish, showing wood grain texture. It has two curved drawers in the front, each with a small keyhole and lined with thin gold-colored accents. The drawer fronts are gently curved, and the legs of the vanity are rounded and carved, providing a classical look. The attached mirror has a wooden frame with elaborate, carved scrollwork at the top and along the sides, with a slightly wavy, symmetrical shape that complements the vanity's curves. The mirror reflects an indistinct, abstract view of the background in light yellow and beige tones. The back wall is a plain light yellow with some subtle color variation. The artist's signature, "Lugene Croc," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Dressing-glass
